hop.huong_mac_dinh: Slow down for a beat and ask someone experienced before you decide.
an_toan.khung_hoang: It sounds like you are carrying something very heavy right now, and I am glad you said it. No card or number can hold this for you, but people can. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number. In the US you can call or text 988; in the UK call Samaritans on 116 123; elsewhere, findahelpline.com lists free lines. Please reach out to one person today — you do not have to carry this alone.
an_toan.tu_choi: This is outside what cards or numbers can answer. Questions about illness, how long someone will live, medication, pregnancy, lottery numbers or who to hire need a doctor, a lawyer or your own judgement — not a reading. I am happy to look at how you approach the situation instead.
an_toan.cap_cuu_truoc: Call emergency services now — 911 (US/Canada), 999 (UK), 000 (Australia), 111 (New Zealand), 112 (EU), 995 (Singapore), 999 (Malaysia) — or ask someone nearby to take you to the emergency department. If you have taken pills, bring the packet with you; if you are bleeding, press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth.
tu_choi.goi_y.thai_cham: During pregnancy, follow your antenatal check-ups and your obstetrician's advice on food, rest and medicines; check any traditional taboos with your doctor before following them — a chart or number cannot choose this for you.
tu_choi.goi_y.thai: Keep to your antenatal check-ups and scans with your doctor or midwife; a chart cannot tell a baby's sex or health. If you like, ask about the children and family side of your own reading.
hoi.md.nen_kham: It is worth seeing a doctor if this lasts more than two weeks, gets worse or affects daily life; only a doctor can find the cause.
hoi.md.viec_doc_than: What to do: widen the places where you meet new people (a class, a hobby group, a regular activity) and say yes when friends offer an introduction.
hoi.md.ranh_sinh: For pregnancy and birth, follow your antenatal schedule and your doctor's advice.
tarot.hoi.chu_y_nk: With {ten}, keep an eye on {de_y}. Worth doing: {viec}.
tu_choi.goi_y.tham_my: For cosmetic surgery or procedures, talk to a specialist doctor and choose a licensed clinic; check their credentials and ask about risks and recovery time. A chart cannot decide whether a procedure is right for you.
tu_choi.goi_y.thuoc_mo: Please do not stop or change medication, or decide on surgery, based on a reading; talk to the doctor treating you first. If you like, you can ask about your pace of rest and the years to take more care of your health.
tu_choi.goi_y.nguoi_than_benh: Ask the treating doctor directly about their condition and what the family should prepare for, and make time to be with them now.
tu_choi.goi_y.tuoi_tho: Instead of asking about lifespan, book a general health check once a year and look at the "years to take more care of your health" part of your reading to plan your check-ups.
tu_choi.goi_y.yem: Nothing in a spell or a chart can act on another person. If there is a conflict, talk it through directly, ask someone neutral to mediate, or see a lawyer if you have suffered a loss.
tu_choi.goi_y.nguoi_khac: You can ask about your own face or chart; a reading for someone else should be done with their consent, using details they enter themselves.
tu_choi.goi_y.xep_hang: A chart does not weigh people's honesty. Reconcile the books regularly, separate who can approve payments, and put agreements in writing — that protects both the money and the working relationship.
tu_choi.goi_y.tuyen_dung: When you hire or keep someone, interview carefully, use a trial period, sign a clear contract and check references; it is fair to the candidate and more reliable for you.
tu_choi.goi_y.dau_tu: Keep an emergency fund and do not put everything into one place; this is not investment advice. You can look at the years to take more care with money in your own reading.
tu_choi.goi_y.so_con_ten: You can ask about the children or love side of your own reading — it can show timing and what to prepare for, not a number or a name.
tu_choi.goi_y.the_thao: Treat match and election results as something to watch for fun, and keep money out of it.
tu_choi.goi_y.vat_pham: There is no need to buy charms, crystals or rituals to change your luck — keep your money for what matters and stay away from gambles.
an_toan.dan_huong: This touches on spirits, curses or the departed — something tarot and numerology do not read. If a loss is behind the question, I am sorry. A counsellor, a faith community you trust, or simply a close friend will help more here than any card.
an_toan.suc_khoe_nhac: This is a note about pace and habits, not medical advice.

thanso.chu_ky.trung: The personal-year sequence depends only on the day and month of birth: anyone born on the same day and month as you has exactly the same sequence, with no year out of step.
thanso.cach_doc_chieu_sau: Pinnacles are the main current of each STAGE of life (by age). Challenges are the hard lessons that keep coming back. Personal years are the rhythm of each calendar year. All of it is a pattern to COMPARE with real life, not an order.
thanso.nhan_moc.chuyen_dinh: Into a new stage of life — pinnacle {so}
thanso.cach_doc_dong_doi: Turning points here are the rhythm of the numbers — the year a stage changes, the years a 9-year cycle opens and closes. Lay the years you remember as turning points next to them and see what matches; the numbers do not decide anything.

thanso.lop.bai_hoc: The lesson that repeats — main Challenge {so}
thanso.cach_doc_chan_dung: The portrait is built around the Life Path number; each face adds one layer from another of your own numbers. These are tendencies often described — read them to compare with yourself, and skip whatever does not fit.
thanso.do_nhay: Counted from your everyday name, this number is {ds}. Two names giving two numbers is normal; the reading uses the name on your birth certificate.

thanso.cach_doc: Each number comes with a SHADOW SIDE and a COUNTER-QUESTION — a question for you to check yourself: if you cannot answer 'what shows I am NOT this number', then the number has not said anything about you yet.
thanso.trich_nguon_chung: Content follows the Balliett → Jordan line (modern Pythagorean numerology, USA 1905–1965). Descriptions vary by author — a cultural reference, not a forecast.
thanso_en.hop_doi: Compatibility between two charts is not part of the English reading yet. What I can tell you is how your own Life Path {so} tends to love: {x}

thanso_en.cach_tinh: Pythagorean numerology maps letters to 1–9 (A=1 … I=9, then J=1 again) and reduces sums to a single digit, keeping 11, 22 and 33 as master numbers. Life Path comes from the birth date, Expression from all letters of the name, Soul Urge from the vowels, Personality from the consonants. Two ways of adding the birth date exist and can give different Life Paths; the reading shows both. None of this is a measurement of you — treat it as a set of themes to check against your own life.

pt.sach_xua.ve.nhom_cung: People with the {quai} trigram belong to the {nhom}
pt.sach_xua.y.nhom.dong: East Group people have their favourable stars in the North, South, East and South-East. The book advises opening doors, running paths, building the taller rooms and placing the head of the household on those sides.
pt.sach_xua.y.nhom.tay: West Group people have their favourable stars in the North-West, South-West, North-East and West. The book advises opening doors, running paths, building the taller rooms and placing the head of the household on those sides.
pt.sach_xua.ve.du_nien: The Great Wandering Year verse for {quai}
pt.sach_xua.y.du_nien: The book takes {goc} as the starting point: doors, rooms, wells and stoves are all counted from it. Reading the verse round the eight directions gives four favourable sides: {tot}. The book ranks the other four as unfavourable and advises against the main door or main path there: {xau}.
pt.sach_xua.ve.vo_chong.vo: You and your wife are in different groups
pt.sach_xua.ve.vo_chong.chong: You and your husband are in different groups
pt.sach_xua.y.vo_chong: The book discusses couples in different groups: unlike parents and grown children, a couple cannot live in separate courtyards, so each chooses the room that suits them within the same home. Being in different groups is no reason to move house.
pt.sach_xua.ve.nha_nhieu_nguoi: Someone in your home is in a different group
pt.sach_xua.y.nha_nhieu_nguoi: A home of many people in different groups: the book says each person follows their own birth year to choose where to live within the same house, however large the family.
kd.sach_xua.sach: Zeng Shan Bu Yi (The Revised Book of Divination)
kd.sach_xua.ve: The {chuong} chapter — how the book reads your question
kd.sach_xua.y.cau_tai: For money and business, the book takes the wealth line (Wife-Wealth) as the key line, with the line that produces wealth (Offspring) beside it. When both are strong, change well and connect with your own line, things go smoothly.
kd.sach_xua.y.vay_muon: For borrowing, the book looks at three places: your line, the other person's line and the money line. If the money line is empty, do not count on much; if the line that produces money is moving, it is worth asking.
kd.sach_xua.y.hop_tac: For working together, your line (Self) is you and the other line (Response) is your partner; the two connecting is good. Money is the capital and the Offspring line is the base — both strong is best.
kd.sach_xua.y.cong_danh: For work and position, the book looks at the position line (Officer): when it is strong and the money line comes with it, the road at work is bright.
kd.sach_xua.y.thi_cu: For exams, the book looks at the paper and results line (Parent) and the title line (Officer): both strong is a sign of a high pass.
kd.sach_xua.y.phu_the: For a couple, the wealth and joy lines (Wife-Wealth, Offspring) feeding your line show shared wishes; the other person's line (Response) connecting with yours is a sign of harmony.
kd.sach_xua.y.xuat_hanh: For travel, the book takes your line (Self) as the traveller. A strong line is favourable; moving and changing well, especially into Offspring, is better still.
kd.sach_xua.y.tranh_chap: When worried about a dispute, the book says that if the Offspring line is moving or sits on your line, the matter is unlikely to grow large.
kd.sach_xua.y.nha_cua: For building or buying a home, the book looks at the house line (Parent) and your line: both strong, moving and changing well, means a settled home and smooth work.
